title: Explorer card
responsibility: Draws supplied content in an article, labelled section or list item with the shared card or module treatment.

inputs.name: Card.as
inputs.description: Selects the rendered element: 'li' renders hx-li, 'section' renders hx-section, and 'article' (the default) or any other value renders hx-article. The component does not validate the value.

inputs.name: Card.variant
inputs.description: 'card' adds the class ex-card to the rendered element; 'module' and any other value add no class, so the class then comes only from tone.

inputs.name: Card.tone
inputs.description: Class names appended unchanged to the rendered element's class, after 'ex-card' when variant is 'card'; an empty string adds nothing. The value is not validated.

inputs.name: Card.id
inputs.description: Native id set on the rendered element; undefined omits the attribute. The component does not check the value's format or uniqueness.

inputs.name: Card.label
inputs.description: Sets aria-label on the rendered element, giving it an accessible name; undefined omits the attribute. The component does not validate the value.

inputs.name: Card.labelledby
inputs.description: Sets aria-labelledby on the rendered element, and undefined omits it. The value is the id of the heading that names the region, and the component does not check that such an element exists.

inputs.name: Card.component
inputs.description: Owning component attribution written unchanged to data-harness-component on the rendered element; undefined omits the attribute. The component does not validate the value.

inputs.name: Card.children
inputs.description: Required Svelte snippet rendered with {@render children()} as the content of the rendered element. Errors thrown while rendering it propagate to the caller.

outputs.name: Card
outputs.description: Renders an hx-li element when as is 'li', an hx-section element when as is 'section', and otherwise an hx-article element, each containing the rendered children. Its class attribute is built from variant and tone, and its id, aria-label, aria-labelledby and data-harness-component attributes are set from the inputs and omitted when undefined.

errors.name: Child snippet error
errors.description: Errors thrown while rendering the required children snippet propagate to the caller; the component has no try/catch around the render.
